# bugdeck

> Open-source Marker.io / BugHerd / Userback alternative: a self-hosted visual bug-report widget for React apps. A user screenshots the page — or points at one element with a devtools-style picker — draws on the shot, writes the report with the pictures inline, and presses Send. It lands on your own server, behind your own auth, and is filed into your issue tracker. MIT, Node >= 20, React >= 18 as a peer, zero telemetry.

Three packages, one repository. `@aitofy/bugdeck` is the React widget your users click,
`@aitofy/bugdeck-server` is the HTTP API that stores reports and files them, and
`@aitofy/bugdeck-core` is the wire contract both speak plus the `IssueTracker` adapters.

The 30-second version:

```bash
pnpm add @aitofy/bugdeck                       # react, react-dom >= 18 are peers
```

```tsx
import { FeedbackWidget } from '@aitofy/bugdeck';
<FeedbackWidget apiBase="http://localhost:3131" />;
```

```bash
PLANE_BASE_URL=… PLANE_API_KEY=… PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG=… PLANE_PROJECT_ID=… \
  npx @aitofy/bugdeck-server                   # listens on :3131

TRACKER=github GITHUB_OWNER=… GITHUB_REPO=… GITHUB_TOKEN=… \
  npx @aitofy/bugdeck-server                   # same, filing into GitHub Issues
```

Already have a server? `createFeedbackApp` is a plain Hono app you mount in it, with your own
`resolveUser(request)` — `null` is a 401. Every link below is a raw file from
https://github.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/README.md): what it is, the comparison table against the paid tools, quick start, how the pieces fit together.
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/llms-full.txt): every document in this list concatenated into one file — read this if you can only read one.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/AGENTS.md): the engineering rules any change to this repository must follow.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): clone, install, the four commands CI runs, and how to add a tracker adapter.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release, written for users.
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability privately.

## Packages

- [@aitofy/bugdeck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/packages/widget/README.md): the React widget — every prop, the ten CSS variables, translating with `strings`, the multipart wire format, and the gotchas that cost a production bug each.
- [@aitofy/bugdeck-server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/packages/server/README.md): the HTTP API — routes and error codes, mounting in an existing Hono or Express server, every environment variable, SQLite storage, and why `AUTH_MODE=header` is not authentication.
- [@aitofy/bugdeck-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/packages/core/README.md): the contract, the two entry points (`/contract` is browser-safe, the root adds `sharp` and the adapters), and how to write a tracker adapter.

## Examples

- [examples/vite-react/src/App.tsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/examples/vite-react/src/App.tsx): the widget in a Vite + React app with a fixed sidebar and a sticky header — the page the element-picker pixel test runs against.
- [examples/server-plane/server.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/examples/server-plane/server.ts): the standalone server in one file, environment in and a listening port out.
- [examples/express-mount/server.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/examples/express-mount/server.ts): the same app mounted inside an existing Express server, authenticated by that server's own session.

## Optional

- [Dockerfile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/Dockerfile): the server as one container.
- [docker-compose.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/docker-compose.yml): that container plus the volume the SQLite file and the screenshots live on.
- [.env.example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/.env.example): every environment variable the standalone server reads, annotated.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitofy-dev/bugdeck/main/LICENSE): MIT.
